title: Show working-tree changes and accurate diffs
description: Present changed files and staged/unstaged diffs from the real Git workspace in a readable, revision-aware review surface.
acceptanceCriteria: Untracked, added, modified, renamed, and deleted files are distinguished from Git status data.
Staged and unstaged changes are shown separately with accurate text diffs.
Binary, oversized, and unsupported content is identified rather than rendered misleadingly.
Selecting a changed file synchronizes the diff, inspector, tree, and 3D selection.

steps.details: Read the selected Git-engine decision and UI state contracts.

steps.description: Implement change list and diff review
steps.details: Bound large data and keep source content escaped.
Cover staged/unstaged, rename/delete, binary, and stale-state cases.

technicalNotes: The displayed diff must come from the Git engine, not inferred scene metadata.
